text: Rutherford appreciation post. The first 3D-printed orbital class engine and one of the highest volume manufactured engines in the world today. We've built and shipped more than 1000 to date.

Launch 101 coming right up. We're preparing to launch our 101st Electron next week to deploy another StriX Earth-imaging spacecraft for synspective. Development ➡️ Production. We've been building Archimedes for scale from day one. As we iterate through stages of engine development testing, we have set up our Engine Development Center in Long Beach to be capable of building and shipping one Archimedes engine every 8 days. Once final development testing is completed we will down-select our final qualification configuration of hardware and will begin delivering engines every 8 days to the stand for flight ATP testing.
